spans.s: kaiṭabha, (once in LV) kaiṭubha, m. (= Pali keṭubha), ritual science (of the Veda; = Skt. kalpa, as a Vedāṅga; so Buddhaghosa on the Pali, see PTSD): for the corrupt text of LV 〔156.18〕 (in list of sciences) ajalakṣaṇe miśṛlakṣaṇe kauṭubheśvaralakṣaṇe nirghaṇṭe, read, with each word confirmed by Tib. and supported by good mss. (except mss. śvara for śva), but order correct only in Tib., all Skt. mss. kaiṭ˚ before śva˚: ajalakṣaṇe miṇḍhalakṣaṇe śvalakṣaṇe kaiṭubhe nirghaṇṭe; Mvy 〔5052〕 kaiṭabhaḥ, following 〔5051〕 nighaṇṭuḥ; otherwise only in Bhvr. cpd. sa-nighaṇṭa- (or nirghaṇṭa-)-kaiṭabha, epithet of veda, along with etymology and ritual science: (vedānāṃ …) sa˚ ˚bhānāṃ Mv 〔i.231.18〕; 〔ii.77.9〕; 〔89.17〕; 〔iii.450.7〕; Av 〔ii.19.7〕; (vedān …) sa˚ ˚bhān Divy 〔619.22〕.
